steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Are my injuries... gone? Injuries that severe, how is that even...

steps.speaker: Eastside Healthcare
steps.content: What's there to be astonished about? Isn't this completely normal?

steps.speaker: Eastside Healthcare
steps.content: This is Eastside, not that outdated Syndicate.
[White flash]

steps.speaker: Nirvana Executive
steps.content: Heh... The Western District is stuck in its old ways, oblivious to the fact that technology has evolved.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Executive
steps.content: The observation of BR-001 has propelled technological progress. We can now achieve super-loop communication, enabling us to defy the laws of time and space within the Black Ring for communication. The mechanized mining by drones has been a reality for quite some time now.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Wh-what does it mean?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Executive
steps.content: It means that the skilled technicians you've been looking up to have become a thing of the past.
[White flash]

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: This could be a dangerous trip. Are you sure you're alright with that?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Amidst adversity, this is the courage required. I'll clear a path for you!
[White flash]

steps.speaker: Nirvana Executive
steps.content: Negotiations... A single command could resolve it, and you wouldn't even realize the system update was happening.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: They're working their hearts out on production, dealing with gang harassment every night. They hardly have a moment...
No one is listening to what he's saying.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Executive
steps.content: Hahaha, you're all complete idiots, believing you can negotiate with us... If it weren't for someone pulling the strings in the media, Nirvana wouldn't even waste time on you...

steps.speaker: Nirvana Executive
steps.content: Now, let's take care of those few influencer accounts. I remember there's a Syndican woman behind them.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Executive
steps.content: Seriously, why bother rescuing him... Those Paradeisians are also a headache...
[White flash]

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Observation has verified that another powerful Mania being has penetrated BR-002, obliterating the anomaly. This resulted in an instant dissipation of over half the energy possessed by the Corpsebornes.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: That intruder bears a striking resemblance to SHP, no... even more formidable. It must be the only experimental subject taken from the Underground lab of Lone Island in N.F. 103.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: So, the purpose of the Black Ring in the Underground... can we describe it as "nourishing"? Allowing the Corpseborne to absorb human Mania through the Black Ring, then feeding the strengthened Corpseborne to SHP.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: The test yielded great success. From BR-002's records, we can roughly infer the Underground's intentions in producing the Black Ring and have a better grasp of SHP's significance. The only downside is that the expenses went beyond my initial estimates.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: What kind of nourishing? What test are you talking about? I thought we were here to negotiate, to talk about the future of the West District. We've put everything on the line, and you're up to what exactly?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Screw you... Are we nothing more than expenses to you? Is human life just an expense to you?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: What do you take us for?!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: Leader, we're all counting on you.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: You hit Nirvana hard last time, proving what the Inner Bay workers are made of. We've still got the power, haven't we?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Revenant
steps.content: We're in a position to talk terms with them, right?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Absolutely! We've reached this point because of our unwavering conviction. Our dreams will come to fruition. If you ever doubt it, just look to your hero! When have I ever disappointed you?

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Help me, I came here to follow you, leader. I... I don't want to die...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Ah... Ah...
[White flash]

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: His strength is remarkable, but mentally, he's teetering on the edge. Rather than defiance, he's overwhelmed by sorrow and regret.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: I believe the marking won't work. I can't resonate with him, and I can't assimilate his Mania.
Hmm... I can sympathize. This man has spent his entire life trapped in Inner Bay, within Syndicate's confines. He's never experienced a larger world, so this must be quite a shock for him.

Recognizing their gap between us and Eastside highlights his intelligence. He has a broader perspective than his obstinate companions, truly befitting of a leader who doesn't readily succumb to blind animosity.
So, sir, would you kindly consider talking to your friends? We've already spent too much time on ruthless interrogations. Your assistance in this matter would be immensely valuable.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Damn you all!!!
See this, X? Just like that, we've got him hooked.

The Underground activity at BR-002 is locked, haha... it's mind-blowing, really. To think, even monstrosities like the Black Ring Corpus are just snacks for that thing. What in the world is going on down there?
Anyway, we hit our mark. Now, let's wrap this up and keep the mess to a minimum.
Go ahead and mark him. That's what a Hush is for.
[White flash]

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: I'm sorry for how Nirvana botched the W-31 situation, but we can't let this worsen and affect more people. It's time to put an end to this.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Give in, let me be your voice, I will take control. That's the power of the mark. I can free your friends.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Your sacrifices won't be meaningless. I'll work with Paradeisos to fine-tune our operation, saving costs along the way.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: I'll remember you; we're all in this... for the greater good of humanity.
[Fade Out]

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I was in the dark.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Whether the victory we were so passionately chasing means anything, how far the enemy we thought we could stand up to has evolved... I was totally out of the loop.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Unaware that the West District's heyday had long gone, blind to my own limitations, yet naively believing I can play the hero to save the world. Ha... how stupid.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Samuel, it's not your fault, nor anyone else's... It was a blind fool who walked you into that dead end. The real mistake has always been mine...
[White flash]

Mired in a contaminated bog, sinister arms intermittently trying to seize the two of you. Donald wakes up to see ${PlayerName} huffing and puffing, dragging him along. He cracks a smile and then, twisting around, begins to swim him to safety.
steps.female_content: Mired in a contaminated bog, sinister arms intermittently trying to seize the two of you. Donald wakes up to see ${PlayerName} huffing and puffing, dragging him along. He cracks a smile and then, twisting around, begins to swim her to safety.

steps.content: That loathsome Schorl floats right by ${PlayerName}, silent for once, like it is keeping a vow, just waiting for the ultimate choice.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Tough break, working so tirelessly with such a small frame. Take it easy now. Donald's up and about, and he's got you covered.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's great you haven't been taken down by Paradeisos, still got that fight in you.
Right, unlike you, having nightmares again.
...You hanging in there?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's nothing. Did a five-six year stint in Banyan Psychiatric Hospital, majored in being a psycho. Nightmares are a nightly thing for me, know them inside out.
With the grappling hook straining under your weight, he inches forward, clutching onto you, every step heavier than the last, while muddled voices invade your thoughts.

steps.speaker: Murky Voice
steps.content: Hero... get us out of here... lead us... to take back what's ours...

steps.speaker: Murky Voice
steps.content: Help me...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Look away, stay positive. We've got a long road ahead, don't sink into gloom.
Do you really think we can shatter this Black Ring?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Why shouldn't we believe?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: The moment I entered this Black Ring, no... actually, when I first laid eyes on that maze outside, something crossed my mind.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's really his handiwork, huh... Was this maze made just to shield those Corpsebornes and block enemies? Is this constantly rising Black Ring High Tower solely for gathering strength for a grand revenge?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You see, while it blocks our path, it also ensnares monsters and so many of the Corruptors. Unlike other Black Rings that expand and devour endlessly, this one, nourished by the Underground, just grows upward, pushing the epicenter of pollution farther away from people.

steps.speaker: Black Ring Avatar
steps.content: But bear in mind... this time, it was my choice to embrace the Black Ring, and it will surely bring to life... my deepest desire.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I've always been too trusting, and it's bitten me before. So, I'm putting my faith in you now, ${PlayerName}. Tell me honestly...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Could Julien still be alive? Does his determination linger in this Black Ring?
...Yes, Julien hasn't thrown in the towel.
Shackles alone couldn't have held back the Black Ring for eight long months. It's his unyielding spirit battling Mania, restraining the Ring.
The Underground had plans to exploit him to harness a more potent and focused Black Ring. However, he flipped the script, snatching a chance to briefly seize control of the Black Ring.
He also steered Hecate to revive my awareness, rescuing me from the clutches of Mania.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Haha, that's a relief to hear. So, this place is essentially a massive Drifter Camp, and Julien? Still the same old Julien!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Don't let his constant self-deprecation and his begging around to be a leader fool you. When it all comes crashing down, when Rustfire hits the hardest, he's always the last one standing.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: He's the genius who created this Drifter Camp in a place like Syndicate—complete with mazes, traps, and hidden paths—in this brutal world, he managed to carve out a sanctuary for the homeless and vulnerable.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I just knew it... This is great! We've got a shot at victory!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ${PlayerName}. Let's head up and track down Julien. You've got those shackles, right? Time to turn the rotten into miraculous, wake him up, and snatch back the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: He claimed the Black Ring was the key to his wish. I know him so well. He never longed for vengeance. What he's always been harping on about is—

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Being an architect and bringing Syndicate back to its heyday!
...It's impossible.
He's gone now.
Eight months... that's too long for either of us to hold on. We're just humans, small and frail, up against a massive force of Mania.
In the final moments, he nudged me forward, ensuring my escape, while he stayed till the very end.
